title: [governed] AGENTS.md and .claude/agents/os-dev.md disagree on who sets a PR assignee at pr_create
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ③ escalation of the spec seat's contract review on PR #29331 (#28655), at head `5f8d7494`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it. Governed surfaces (Tier S/H): the fix needs a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval.

## What disagrees

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` says `pr_create` carries no assignees and the dev never sets one (the #28655 dev followed it and declared it as a deviation).
- `AGENTS.md` says the PR's assignee mirrors the card's, set by the executor.

A dev following one breaks the other, and each card thread re-litigates it in its report.

## Done when

One rule, stated in one place and referenced from the other: who sets the PR assignee (the dev at `pr_create`, or the seat at landing), and whether the relay's `pr_create` op accepts it.

Dedupe: none found on `assignee pr_create os-dev`. **New.**
